Telegram WebApp bridge, vendored unchanged from @twa-dev/sdk 8.0.2:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@twa-dev/sdk/v/8.0.2
Source file: dist/telegram-web-apps.js
License: MIT; see telegram-web-app-LICENSE.txt.

Only the standalone vanilla JavaScript bridge is included. No React runtime or
external SDK request is needed. This local, versioned file works under /racing/.
